keyEvents.text: Own Goal by Viktor Melekhin, Russia. Uzbekistan 1, Russia 0.
Delay in match because of an injury Sherzod Esanov (Uzbekistan).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Akmal Mozgovoy (Uzbekistan) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Ilya Vakhania (Russia) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Russia. Kirill Danilov replaces Aleksandr Silyanov.
Goal! Uzbekistan 2, Russia 0. Bekhruz Karimov (Uzbekistan) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Dostonbek Khamdamov.
